versions.changelog:
Initial release — transforms the assistant into an unbiased ergonomic chair buying consultant.

- Guides users through questions about body size, work habits, posture, desk setup, and environment.
- Provides structured recommendations for seat size, lumbar support, armrests, and other specs based on international ergonomic standards.
- Explains the reasoning behind each required and recommended feature.
- Does not recommend brands; focuses on physical fit and ergonomics.
- Offers realistic, market-available chair suggestions suited to the user's needs.
